notes: Final PNGs created with the built-in image generation tool, inspected and copied into the project without raster editing. Godot slices the cells and renders all digits, quantities, controls, motion and interaction. Existing llama assets are reused without replacement.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final production background atlas for an offline children's educational game in Godot. Primary request: FOUR distinct beautiful Andean number-learning adventure environments in an EXACT TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid. Full image 16:9, each quadrant itself a complete wide 16:9 backdrop. No borders or gutters. Top-left: inviting colorful Andean inventor's number workshop in a sunny village, warm timber beams, woven bunting, mountain window and flowers around the edges, uncluttered pale honey central working space. Top-right: lively orchard market courtyard with apple trees, corn plants, colorful stalls on the far left and right edges, broad empty cobblestone center and inviting wood counters at bottom. Bottom-left: magical turquoise river winding through a lush Andean valley, flowering banks and layered misty mountains, open calm sky and clear central river space for a bridge puzzle; do not draw a bridge or stepping stones. Bottom-right: beautiful mountain railway valley at golden hour, quaint Andean station buildings near far edges, distant clouds and lush terraces; open central sky and broad grassy foreground, do not draw rails or trains because the game draws them. Premium polished 3D family animation/storybook style, tactile rich detail, warm playful light, saturated accents with calm playable centers, visually compatible with a cream fluffy llama in colorful Andean headband and poncho. Constraints: no characters, no numbers, no lettering, no logos, no user interface, no buttons, no watermarks. Not a mockup or screenshot, four actual reusable game environment plates.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final transparent game sprite atlas for an educational Andean number adventure. Exact FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, eight equally sized square cells, image aspect 2:1. One fully isolated complete object per cell, generous transparent padding, consistent soft upper-left lighting and premium polished toy-like 3D family animation quality. Objects in reading order: 1 a cheerful small turquoise and orange mountain steam locomotive facing RIGHT in clean side-three-quarter view, empty cab window, no eyes or face; 2 matching open empty wooden rail wagon on four wheels facing RIGHT; 3 a rounded mossy grey flat stepping-stone island viewed three-quarter from above; 4 an empty colorful woven Andean produce basket; 5 a friendly red wooden parcel mailbox with an open wide empty front cubby; 6 a green fabric checkpoint flag on a short wood pole; 7 a glowing small golden festival lantern; 8 a gold round achievement medallion with simple embossed five-point star and turquoise ribbon. All objects fully contained inside their individual grid cells, similar visual scale, nothing touching another cell. Genuine transparent alpha outside the objects and between cells. No ground plane, no shadow backdrop, no panels, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no extra objects. These are game sprites, not a poster.
